priorityDefinitions.P1: Research, verify and write in the first documentation expansion, never publish unverified.
priorityDefinitions.P2: Publish only after high-value P1 work and real support demand or source-backed feature testing.
priorityDefinitions.P3: Requires explicit current-release, community-policy or future-feature verification.
